checks: The source determinant ratio is relative to Q, so its denominator is q rather than v. Omitting an actual strict hit row yields exactly A(q)=(N/2)log N+log q.
Subtracting the entire excess volume q-v from each Q cap is valid individually; its logarithmic weighted sum subtracts precisely (q-v)S. Chebyshev/Jensen then produce the stated expression R_d(v,q).
The replacement S>=N log N has the correct direction because actual source existence forces A(q)>=0. E=0 and Q-boundary cases are separately correct.
Rewriting R_d as Gamma+E(1/2-Gamma)-(1-Gamma)(q-v)-E log q/(N log N) is exact. The proposed excess condition implies q<1 when v<1, including d=1, so the logarithmic term gives a strict surplus.

A full-rank positive relation among d+1 gradients has one-dimensional relation space and no zero gradient. The normalized nonnegative affine functions sum to one and map onto the barycentric affine hyperplane, producing a bounded circumscribed simplex with the claimed matching positive cap orientations.
The final necessary strict lower bound on circumscribed volume excess follows by contrapositive and does not assert an unproved global geometric restriction.
scope: This is an all-point certificate for a full-rank d+1 positive fan with sufficiently small matching circumscribed simplex volume. It allows arbitrary convex middle bodies but requires actual simplex sources. It does not handle arbitrary fan rank/member count or prove a center satisfying all directions.
